title: vpg pairwise judge verdict (vpg-judge-verdict/v1)
description: What a judging agent returns for a packet: one pick per presentation, by position (first, second or tie), with the rule ids it relied on and timecoded evidence. `vpg judge score` unblinds it with the key, merges the two orders of each pair (a disagreement is a tie), checks the hidden anchors and ranks with Bradley-Terry.

judge.description: the judging agent's id, e.g. agent:pairwise-critic
